positions.title: President
positions.description:
•	Structured complex $83 million taxable bond placement for nonprofit healthcare system.
•	Testimony, research and damages calculations for complex legal cases related to corporate and municipal bonds, mortgage-backed securities, commercial real estate, and receivables.
•	Advised the Hunt Companies on a $102 million commercial real estate partnership acquisition, including due diligence on municipal bond financings.
•	Expert report on value of education loan portfolios for transfer tax purposes.
•	Provided expert report to leading international bank, recommending a municipal bond interest rate index replacement to manage its risk.  
•	Developed groundbreaking theory on bond portfolio dynamics with a financial economist.  Our work has been presented to the UK Debt Management Office and the Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas.
•	Presented to the Brookings Institution, the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago, the National Association of Municipal Advisors, and other conferences, seminars and groups. 
•	Created transparent method for estimating effective duration with standard prepayment models.
•	Articles on financial markets appeared in the Financial Times, The Bond Buyer, Pensions and Investments, and the Municipal Finance Journal.
•	Validated models for renewable energy cash flows and healthcare debt capacity.

positions.title: Senior Vice President, Founding CFO
positions.description:
Co-founder and financial leader of company which grew to $7 billion in loans.       ·   Responsibilities include pricing, hedging, valuation, management of financings, financial
           projections and the optimization of loan servicing.
       ·   Instrumental in building student loan portfolio. Priced loans using own proprietary model.
           Negotiated and arranged loan purchases with dozens of clients.
       ·   Assembled and managed the Finance Group, consisting of financial analysts and database
           programmers.
       ·   Led development of data warehouse to integrate heterogeneous data from multiple servicers.
       ·   Oversaw issuance and operation of more than $6 billion in asset-backed securitizations.
           Pioneering transactions included:
                First floating-rate securitization of U.S. assets into Canadian market.
                First A-rated, uninsured student loan interest margin securities.
                Exchanged student loans for tax-exempt bonds to collateralize a tender option bond
                program.
       ·   Managed more than $1.5 billion in short-term conduit financings.
        ·   Hedged basis risk and saved more than $1 million by competitively bidding interest rate swap.
        ·   Steered development of automated purchasing system, enabling company to minimize head count
            to one employee per $300 million in assets.
        ·   Negotiated with clients, bankers, derivative providers and investment providers.

positions.title: Vice President
positions.description:
·   Helped build student loan enterprise within GMAC, funded from a $3 billion shelf registration
            with SEC for asset-backed securities and from GMAC's balance sheet.
        ·   Responsibilities included pricing, valuations, investment, hedging and overseeing investment
            bankers.
        ·   Built advanced pricing model that was key part of intellectual property later acquired by GCO

positions.title: Managing Director, Investment Banking
positions.description:
·   Structured asset-backed securities based on pools of small business loans, student loans,
            delinquent tax penalty receivables and municipal utility loans. Was firm's leading authority on
            "state revolving fund" environmental loan programs.
        ·   Obtained copyright registration for model to optimize selection of bonds for refinancing, helping
            firm to win billions of dollars in bond underwriting business.
        ·   Developed database/cash flow system to analyze large bond portfolios.
        ·   Served Colorado Department of Transportation as Financial Advisor on $1.7 billion construction
            program. Coauthored financial plans for U.S. Department of Transportation.
        ·   Built superior model to help firm become lead banker on $155 million securitization of delinquent
            tax penalties that was part of bankruptcy recovery plan; ·   Designed and led quantitative training program for investment bankers.
        ·   Built Monte Carlo model to assess viability of pension obligation bonds.
        ·   Designed structured equity derivative for pension fund.

honors.title: 2025 Galileo Award
honors.description:
2025 Galileo Award

This award recognizes select senior leaders who exhibit dedicated excellence in assimilating a sustainable patent strategy for their line of business.


Exemplifying thought leadership, advocacy, and collaboration to drive technology advancements
Win Smith has been an influential thought leader within Enterprise Functions Technology and a passionate champion of Wells Fargo’s patent program.
 
As a senior leader, he integrates patent strategy into planning and delivery: initiatives are reviewed for novelty and defensibility, aligned to customer impact and risk excellence, and translated into well structured disclosures in partnership with the Patent Group.
 
Win was an inventor on some of our earliest generative AI filings and continues to drive advancements across AI and other high tech domains, ensuring our portfolio tracks to enterprise priorities.
 
Beyond his personal contributions, Win builds an inclusive inventor culture.  He actively promotes Patent Group resources, sponsors ideation sessions, and mentors first time inventors—from refining problem statements to shaping claim worthy solutions—turning curiosity into contribution.
 
Colleagues point to his combination of strategic foresight, technical depth, and disciplined execution.  He collaborates across functions, celebrates diverse perspectives, and insists on responsible innovation that reflects Wells Fargo’s vision and values.

In short, Win is a senior leader who consistently embeds IP thinking into his line of business; a future focused innovator who pairs practical delivery with superlative technical insight; and a values driven mentor who grows the inventor community while strengthening Wells Fargo’s patent portfolio.

patents.title: Document set interrogation tool
patents.description: Disclosed herein is a workflow for a chatbot system based on an ad hoc set of documents. The chatbot enables users to ask questions  of these documents.  The workflow then searches for relevant information and generates a response. The response may include an answer to a question and a relevant section of a document.
